generated_from.pain_hypothesis: Collecting candidate resumes through unstandardized Google Forms and personal Gmail accounts during hiring drives creates heavy manual coordination overhead and potential candidate drop-off.

emails.subject: off-campus drive applications
emails.body:
I saw your off-campus hiring drive posts directing candidate resumes to a Google Form and a Gmail address.

I am Agnesh, building MNGO. We are early and currently onboarding our first partner colleges. Rather than guessing what recruiters need, we are designing our campus placement software directly around real hiring workflows.

When you run off-campus or campus drives using forms and email, what breaks most often in your process?

Best,
Agnesh
emails.trigger_used: Job posts for off-campus hiring drives direct candidates to submit resumes via Google Forms and a personal Gmail address (techbengaluru4@gmail.com).
emails.trigger_link: Managing candidate applications through Google Forms and Gmail creates friction when scaling campus or off-campus hiring drives.

emails.subject: scaling campus hiring for FY28
emails.body:
Happiest Minds' merger targeting US$ 1 billion in revenue by FY28 will naturally require expanding your engineering intake.

In my conversations with hiring leads, campus recruitment usually breaks around unstructured candidate data—endless PDF resumes and back-and-forth email chains with college placement cells, making cross-campus evaluation almost impossible.

Does this match what your team experiences during campus drives, or is your friction somewhere else?

Best,
Agnesh
emails.trigger_used: Happiest Minds announced a merger with ITC Infotech to create a technology services enterprise targeting US$ 1 billion in revenue by FY28.
emails.trigger_link: Scaling toward a billion-dollar revenue target requires ramping up campus hiring across multiple colleges efficiently.

emails.subject: fresh engineering talent for Rel(AI)Build
emails.body:
Following the launch of Rel(AI)Build, finding strong entry-level software talent will likely remain a priority for Happiest Minds.

We are building campus placement infrastructure and onboarding our first colleges right now. If we brought you a pre-screened, structured shortlist of final-year engineering candidates from these campuses, would you be open to reviewing it?

It costs nothing and commits you to nothing. Would you be open to a brief call to discuss this?

Best,
Agnesh
emails.trigger_used: Happiest Minds launched Rel(AI)Build, an agentic AI platform for enterprise software delivery, on June 11, 2026.
emails.trigger_link: Building enterprise software delivery platforms like Rel(AI)Build requires a consistent pipeline of fresh engineering talent.
